## The Requirement of National Development

::: {.column width="50%"}

![Source: 共产党员网](https://drhuyue.site:10002/sammo3182/figure/inequality_xijinping.png){fig-align="center" height=400}

:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

> [实现共同富裕不仅是经济问题，而且是**关系党的执政基础的重大政治问题**……**让人民群众真真切切感受到共同富裕不仅仅是一个口号，而是看得见、摸得着、真实可感的事实**。]{.red} [@XiJinPing2021d]

:::

::::

::: {.notes}

开场的定位：共同富裕是应对现阶段中国社会的主要矛盾，人民日益增长的美好生活需要和不平衡不充分的发展之间的矛盾，这一问题的伟大实践。

2021年1月11日，中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平在省部级主要领导干部学习贯彻党的十九届五中全会精神专题研讨班在中央党校（国家行政学院）开班式上发表重要讲话。

“看得见、摸得着、真实可感”这十个字本身就是一个认知命题：政策效果最终要落到人的感受上。既有的不平等研究大量讨论分配、福利、增长，认知维度讨论得不多。今天的交流就从这里切入。

:::

:::

解决不平衡发展、经济不平等，不仅是中国之问，也是一个世界之问：

图是美国近数十年的基尼系数轨迹，用作本次讨论“高不平等语境”的经验背景。

中位选民定理的预期是：不平等上升，低于中位的多数人从再分配中获益更多，因此需求应当上升 [@MeltzerRichard1981]。经验上没有发生。这个落差就是全场的引擎。

![Source: Generated by ChatGPT](https://drhuyue.site:10002/sammo3182/figure/inequality_dontCare.png){fig-align="center" height=330}

:::

::::

::: {.notes}

左栏是三十年文献的共识：不平等对社会肌理、对民主政治、对社会凝聚力都是负向的。

右栏是缺口。Whyte 的长期调查显示中国公众对不平等的容忍主要来自功绩制信念、发展叙事与上升预期 [@Whyte2010; @Whyte2016]。但“为什么容忍”这个问题，文献大多直接断言一条从不平等到态度的直线，很少去找中间步骤。

Don't know, don't care [@Bottero2019]

:::


## What will you learn today

1. Substantively, 
  - **What**: what economic inequality shapes on sociopolitical cognition
      - Object: class consciousness and belief in meritocracy
  - **How**: how those effects travel from the macro to the micro
      - Object: objective inequality to political trust
2. Methodologically: 
  - How [observational data]{.red} and ordinary tools support causal conclusions

::: {.callout-tip .fragment}

No experiment, no DID, no RD, no synthetic control. *Regression-ish methods only*.

:::

三项任务对应三个板块，也对应三篇已发表的工作。

要提前说明第三点的分寸：这不是说普通回归可以替代实验设计，而是说在实验不可得的领域，推断的可信度来自设计阶段的选择、估计阶段的纪律、以及主动的推翻检验，而不是估计量本身的名气。

:::


# What

What does inequality shape?


## Two Theories, Opposite Predictions

::::{.overlay-container}

::: {.overlay-image}

::: {.r-hstack}

![Source: Reddit·r/AutisticUnion](https://drhuyue.site:10002/sammo3182/figure/inequality_classConsciousness.webp){.fragment fig-align="center" height=460}

![Source: *Zootopia* (2016)](https://drhuyue.site:10002/sammo3182/figure/mod_zootopia.gif){.fragment fig-align="center" height=460}

:::

:::

::: {.overlay-text-over .fragment}

- **Conflict theory**: under high inequality, the poor gain class consciousness [&uarr;]{.blue} and reject meritocracy [&uarr;]{.blue}
    - Premise: social structures are [self-negating]{.red}
- **Relative power theory**: the poor do [not]{.grayLight} gain class consciousness, and believe in meritocracy [more]{.blue}
    - Premise: social structures [reproduce themselves]{.red} [@GoodinDryzek1980]

:::

::::

:::{.notes}

Class: bourgeoisie, proletariat。功绩制信念是美国梦的核心，也是穷人希望的来源。

Conflict theory：暴露于本地不平等提高穷人对自身劣势位置的感知，激发阶级意识。对手论文的原话是，这“increases the salience of their disadvantaged position within a conspicuous local economic hierarchy”。

Relative power theory：金钱是政治资源。不平等越大，富人越有能力在公共领域传播自己的观点，穷人越缺乏抵抗的资源，于是内化强者的价值与规则。

图片出处：
- https://www.reddit.com/r/AutisticUnion/comments/1dy10wo/what_was_youre_class_consciousness_moment/
- https://sipofstarrshine.com/2016/03/15/zootopia-2016/

:::

## "When Statisticians Lie"

::::{.overlay-container}

::: {.overlay-image}

![@NewmanEtAl2015](https://drhuyue.site:10002/sammo3182/figure/mod_NJL_plot.png){fig-align="center" height=500}

:::{.notes}

Newman, Benjamin J., Christopher D. Johnston, and Patrick L. Lown. 2015. “False Consciousness or Class Awareness? Local Income Inequality, Personal Economic Position, and Belief in American Meritocracy.” American Journal of Political Science 59(2): 326–40.

:::

:::

::: {.overlay-text-over .fragment}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Reject}_{ij} = {}& \mathbf{X}\beta + \beta_{10}\text{Income}_{ij} + \color{red}{\beta_{01}}\text{Inequality}_j \\
                        & + \color{red}{\beta_{11}}(\text{Inequality}_j \times \text{Income}_{ij}) + u_{ij}
\end{aligned}
$$

[$$\frac{\partial\ \text{Reject}_{ij}}{\partial\ \text{Inequality}_j} = \color{red}{\beta_{01}} + \color{red}{\beta_{11}}\cdot\text{Income}_{ij}$$]{.fragment}

::: {.notes}

NJL reads $\hat\beta_{01}$ and $\hat\beta_{11}$ [directly]{.red} as proof that the effect of inequality reverses sign across income.

$\beta_{01}$ alone is the effect [only]{.red} at Income $=0$ — but in NJL's data Income$_{ij}\in[0.21,\,1]$, [never zero]{.red}. A coefficient is not a conditional effect.

:::

:::

::::


## What the wrong interpretation looks like

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}

```{r}
#| label: simInteraction
#| include: false

# income (moderated variable) on NJL's recoded scale; ses is a control that tracks income closely
income_i <- sample(seq(0.21, 1, length.out = 9), 3000, replace = TRUE)
ses <- income_i + rnorm(3000, sd = 0.08)
inequality <- runif(3000, -sqrt(3), sqrt(3))

logit_p <- -0.6 -
  0.4 * (income_i - 0.605) -
  0.4 * (ses - 0.605) -
  0.20 * inequality * (income_i - 0.605)
reject <- rbinom(3000, 1, plogis(logit_p))

model_sim <- glm(
  reject ~ income_i * inequality + ses,
  family = binomial,
  data = tibble(reject, income_i, inequality, ses)
)

coef_interaction <- summary(model_sim)$coefficients["income_i:inequality", ]

# income's conditional effect at the lowest and highest inequality, compared as two independent distributions
vc <- vcov(model_sim)
ends <- range(inequality)
effect_ends <- coef(model_sim)["income_i"] +
  ends * coef(model_sim)["income_i:inequality"]
se_ends <- sqrt(
  vc["income_i", "income_i"] +
    ends^2 * vc["income_i:inequality", "income_i:inequality"] +
    2 * ends * vc["income_i", "income_i:inequality"]
)
z_ends <- diff(effect_ends) / sqrt(sum(se_ends^2))
p_ends <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(z_ends))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-interactionFallacy

interplot(model_sim, var1 = "income_i", var2 = "inequality", ralpha = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Local inequality",
    y = "Conditional effect of income",
    title = sprintf(
      "Interaction coefficient = %.2f (SE = %.2f, p = %.3f)",
      coef_interaction["Estimate"],
      coef_interaction["Std. Error"],
      coef_interaction["Pr(>|z|)"]
    ),
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Lowest vs. highest inequality: z = %.2f, p = %.2f",
      z_ends,
      p_ends
    )
  )
```

:::

::: {.column .fragment width="50%"}

```{r}
#| label: fig-interactionFallacyPredPro

interplot(
  model_sim,
  var1 = "income_i",
  var2 = "inequality",
  predPro = TRUE,
  var2_vals = c(min(inequality), max(inequality)),
  ralpha = 0.3
) +
  labs(
    x = "Personal income",
    y = "Pr(reject meritocracy), %",
    fill = "Inequality",
    color = "Inequality",
    title = "Predicted probability at the lowest and highest inequality"
  ) +
  scale_color_gb(labels = c("Lowest", "Highest")) +
  scale_fill_gb(labels = c("Lowest", "Highest")) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

:::

::::

::: {.notes}

模拟数据，仅作示意，不是复现 NJL 的实际估计（N = 3000，seed 86）。

交互项系数显著：β̂ = −0.31，p = .040。按 NJL 的读法，调节效应就此成立。

左图看边际效应。不平等取最低值时，收入的条件效应是 −0.99，95% CI 为 [−2.12, 0.13]。取最高值时是 −2.05，CI 为 [−3.20, −0.91]。两个区间重叠了较窄区间宽度的约 54%，而且每一端的点估计都落在另一端的置信区间内。把两端的条件效应当作两个独立的分布来比较，z = −1.29，p = .20，差异不显著。从最平等到最不平等，收入效应的变化远不如交互项的 p 值看上去那么确定。

右图用 predPro 画预测概率。不平等取最低值和最高值时的两条曲线，在整个收入区间内都重叠。

为什么会这样：收入与一个 SES 控制变量高度相关（r ≈ .96），收入自身的效应因此估计得很不精确，边际效应的置信带很宽。交互项的系数却不受这个共线性影响，照样显著。所以解读调节效应必须看边际效应和它的置信区间，不能只看交互项系数的显著性。

备问：如果展示回归表，ses 的系数（+0.61）与真实值（−0.4）符号相反，这是共线性所致。另外，interplot 的 CI(Max − Min) 由 Δz × β̂ 抽样得到，与交互项的 Wald 检验等价，本例中为 [−2.09, −0.03]。所以图上不显示 stats_cp。

:::

## Do It Right

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column .fragment width="35%"}

::: {.r-stack}

![Source: @SoltEtAl2017](https://drhuyue.site:10002/sammo3182/figure/inequality_class1.png)

![W. correct method. Source: @SoltEtAl2016](https://drhuyue.site:10002/sammo3182/figure/mod_interaction1.jpg){.fragment height=500 fig-align="center"}

:::

:::

::: {.column .fragment width="35%"}

![W. better data. Source: @SoltEtAl2016](https://drhuyue.site:10002/sammo3182/figure/mod_SH_plot2.png){fig-align="center" height=500}

:::

::: {.column .fragment width="30%"}


![Marginal effects; Source: @SoltEtAl2016](https://drhuyue.site:10002/sammo3182/figure/interaction2.jpg){fig-align="center" height=500}

:::

::::


::: {.notes}

第一条是全场方法论的主线。正确做法是对模型求偏导得到条件效应，并在所有观测到的收入取值上计算。Brambor、Clark 与 Golder 的原话是：交互项的构成项“indicates only the effect of Inequality when the other variable in the interaction, Income, takes on the value of zero”，而且“cannot even infer whether X has a meaningful conditional effect on Y from the magnitude and significance of the coefficient on the interaction term”。

第二条：三种测量分别是 2005、2006 的二择一题，2007 的两句四点量表同时同意，2009 的只取其中一句。1999 至 2012 年所有 Pew 调查的时间序列显示三者水平差异巨大，原文的判断是“pooling them into a single analysis cannot be justified”，结论一句更狠：“The results presented in NJL are an artifact generated by the decision to pool these three very different measures together.”

第三条：对手称那些题项是 2006 年调查独有，实际上“were not at all unique to the 2006 survey: they were in fact included in six Pew surveys during the period examined in the study, 2005 to 2009”。于是 2017 的结论是“In neglecting to examine more than a single survey, NJL reaches a conclusion that is not supported by the available evidence”。

:::


## Wrap up

- Higher inequality [&rarr;]{.large} the poor: 
    - Reject meritocracy [less]{.red}
    - [Less]{.red} likely to gain class consciousness


::: {.notes}

2016 的预测概率：最低收入组从观测到的最低不平等水平移到最高水平，拒绝功绩制的概率下降 19 个百分点（正负 7）；4 万至 5 万美元组从 37%（正负 2）降到 30%（正负 3）；最高收入组在整个不平等区间内与零无异。

2017 的三个面板：收入本身的条件效应在整个不平等区间显著为负，且随不平等升高而增大；不平等的系数只在收入高于 5 万美元的人群中显著，与对手的预测完全相反；最低收入组的 have-not 自我认同预测概率在不平等区间上是平的。

结论的重量在这里：“the current social structure will not simply undermine itself”。改变只能来自有组织的努力，原文说“will only result from concerted effort, from the difficult and much-constrained work of organization and mobilization”。

两篇都用 interplot 算条件效应、dotwhisker 画系数图，系数按两倍标准差重标度以便跨变量比较 [@Gelman2008]。

:::


# How

How does macro inequality reach the micro mind?

## Is your world economically equal or not?

[*How do you know?*]{.red}

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column .fragment width="50%"}

*Common measures*

- S80/S20 Ratio: The richest 20% / the poorest 20%
- Palma Ratio: The richest 10% / the poorest 40%
- [Gini Coefficient:]{.fragment .highlight-red} The cumulative percentage of total income / the cumulative percentage of the population, starting from the poorest

:::

::: {.column .fragment width="50%"}

![](https://drhuyue.site:10002/sammo3182/figure/gini.gif){fig-align="center" height=400}

:::

::::

::: {.notes}

Each measure looks at a different slice of the distribution, which is exactly why they can disagree about the same society.

:::

## Illustration

```{r}
#| label: fakeData

create_society_from_quintiles <- function(
  quintile_shares,
  n_population = 1000,
  total_income = 50000000
) {
  # Check that quintile shares sum to 1 (or 100 if in percentage)
  if (sum(quintile_shares) > 1.1) {
    quintile_shares <- quintile_shares / 100
  }
  if (abs(sum(quintile_shares) - 1) > 0.01) {
    stop("Quintile shares must sum to 1 or 100.")
  }

  # Calculate income for each quintile
  quintile_incomes <- total_income * quintile_shares

  # Number of people per quintile
  n_per_quintile <- n_population / 5

  # Calculate average income within each quintile
  avg_incomes_per_quintile <- quintile_incomes / n_per_quintile

  # Generate individual incomes with some random noise around the quintile average
  income_data <- c()
  for (i in 1:5) {
    # Generate incomes from a normal distribution centered on the quintile's average
    quintile_group_incomes <- rnorm(
      n = n_per_quintile,
      mean = avg_incomes_per_quintile[i],
      sd = avg_incomes_per_quintile[i] * 0.15
    )
    # Ensure no income is negative
    quintile_group_incomes[
      quintile_group_incomes < 0
    ] <- avg_incomes_per_quintile[i] * 0.1
    income_data <- c(income_data, quintile_group_incomes)
  }

  return(round(income_data))
}

# Source: Approximate data from World Bank/OECD
quintiles_slovenia <- c(0.093, 0.139, 0.175, 0.224, 0.369) # Low Inequality
quintiles_usa <- c(0.036, 0.088, 0.141, 0.226, 0.509) # Medium Inequality
quintiles_safrica <- c(0.025, 0.051, 0.092, 0.179, 0.653) # High Inequality

# Data for the low inequality society (modeled on Slovenia)
income_low <- create_society_from_quintiles(quintiles_slovenia)

# Data for the medium inequality society (modeled on the USA)
income_medium <- create_society_from_quintiles(quintiles_usa)

# Data for the high inequality society (modeled on South Africa)
income_high <- create_society_from_quintiles(quintiles_safrica)

# --- Step 2: Create a function to calculate all measures ---

calculate_metrics <- function(income, society_name) {
  # Gini Coefficient
  gini <- ineq(income, type = "Gini")

  # Sort income to find quantiles
  income_sorted <- sort(income)
  n <- length(income_sorted)

  # Palma Ratio (Top 10% share / Bottom 40% share)
  income_top10_share <- sum(income_sorted[floor(n * 0.9):n]) /
    sum(income_sorted)
  income_bottom40_share <- sum(income_sorted[1:floor(n * 0.4)]) /
    sum(income_sorted)
  palma <- income_top10_share / income_bottom40_share

  # S80/S20 Ratio (Top 20% total income / Bottom 20% total income)
  income_top20 <- sum(income_sorted[floor(n * 0.8):n])
  income_bottom20 <- sum(income_sorted[1:floor(n * 0.2)])
  s80_s20 <- income_top20 / income_bottom20

  # Return a data frame
  data.frame(
    Society = society_name,
    Gini = gini,
    Palma = palma,
    S80_S20 = s80_s20
  )
}

# Calculate metrics for each society
metrics_low <- calculate_metrics(income_low, "Low Inequality")
metrics_medium <- calculate_metrics(income_medium, "Medium Inequality")
metrics_high <- calculate_metrics(income_high, "High Inequality")

# Combine into a single data frame
all_metrics <- bind_rows(metrics_low, metrics_medium, metrics_high)

# --- Step 3: Visualize the results with ggplot2 ---

# First, visualize the income distributions
income_df <- data.frame(
  Income = c(income_low, income_medium, income_high),
  Society = factor(
    rep(
      c("Low Inequality", "Medium Inequality", "High Inequality"),
      each = 1000
    ),
    levels = c("Low Inequality", "Medium Inequality", "High Inequality")
  )
)

# Now, prepare data for comparing the inequality metrics
metrics_long <- all_metrics %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Gini, Palma, S80_S20),
    names_to = "Measure",
    values_to = "Value"
  )
```

## Output Evaluation vs. Mediator Evaluation

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}

**Output Evaluation Model**

Inequality is a [system output]{.red}; citizens evaluate it and blame the government [@Easton1965]

*Four hidden assumptions*

1. Perceive inequality accurately
2. Regard it as [important]{.red}
3. Hold retrospective views
4. Attribute blame to government

:::

::: {.column .fragment width="50%"}

**Mediator Evaluation Model** [@JinEtAl2024]

Citizens do not evaluate inequality; they [experience]{.red} it

*Less demanding*

- Easier to judge how government treated you than how unequal society is
- Multiple paths, [one is enough]{.red}

:::

::::

::: {.callout-note .fragment}

## Not the "perceived inequality" turn

Relaxing accurate perception still assumes citizens consider inequality important [@GimpelsonTreisman2018]

:::

::: {.notes}

这是该文的核心理论贡献，也是原版幻灯片没有讲的部分。

OEM 的四个假设即便在信息充分的民主国家也备受挑战。MEM 的主张是：“as long as high inequality exists, the mediation processes link higher inequality to lower political trust, regardless of whether this inequality is understood.”

重要的分寸：作者明确反对退回到“只有被正确感知的不平等才有后果”。客观不平等依然是分析焦点，因为它强有力地塑造社会条件，只是作用方式是间接的。

:::


## People can feel inequality in *various* ways [@JinEtAl2024]

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}

::: {.r-vstack}

![Impartial governance](https://drhuyue.site:10002/sammo3182/figure/inequality_collusion.jpg){fig-align="center" height=250}

![Government Non-responsiveness](https://drhuyue.site:10002/sammo3182/figure/inequality_nonresponse.jpg){.fragment fig-align="center" height=250}

:::

:::{.notes}

Impartial governance: 

- The damage of economic disparities on political equality in democracies has been well documented in the literature [@SchlozmanEtAl2013]. 
- Formal and informal institutions exist in non-democracies to convert economic resources into political influence and favorable treatment. 
- Wealthy Chinese private entrepreneurs form extensive connections with local government officials to gain privileges [@ChenDickson2010]. 

Government Non-responsiveness: 

- Substantial evidence indicates that economic inequality reduces social capital and generates distrust and social conflicts. 
- Class conflict theory suggests that in highly unequal societies, people's perceptions of economic positions on the social ladder are accentuated [@KrausEtAl2013]. 
- Low levels of social capital and accentuated social conflicts make governance difficult: @BaldwinHuber2010 showed that income differences make agreement on which public goods to provide more difficult, and therefore have a negative relationship with public goods provision [@EppJennings2020].

:::

:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

::: {.r-vstack}

![Judicial Injustice](https://drhuyue.site:10002/sammo3182/figure/inequality_judicialInjustice.jpg){.fragment fig-align="center" height=250}

![Anti-Corruption Inadequacy](https://drhuyue.site:10002/sammo3182/figure/inequality_anticorruption.jpg){.fragment fig-align="center" height=250}

:::


:::{.notes}

Judicial Injustice:

1. Greater inequality implies that the well-off have more resources to control the legal apparatus while the poor are more disadvantaged.
1. The advantaged are motivated to attempt such control because of intensified social conflicts.

Anti-Corruption Inadequacy:

When inequality leads to widespread corruption, citizens doubt governments' intentions and abilities to combat corruption and perceive governments as incompetent to address the problems of the system. 

人言包相是铁面，却原来官官相护有牵连

- photo links:
    - https://ncnewsline.com/2020/04/27/scales-of-injustice/

:::

:::

::::



## Examining the Chinese Case [@JinEtAl2024]


:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="60%"}
Data:

- *Chinese Household Finance Survey* 2013
- *China Urban Governance Survey* 2015

:::

::: {.column width="40%"}

Method: *Mediation analysis*

+ Multi-mediator estimation
+ central and local gov

:::

::::

:::{.notes}

Imai 2014, mediation analysis for causal mechanism and non binary treatment

:::


![](https://drhuyue.site:10002/sammo3182/figure/mediation.png){.fragment fig-align="center" height=350}



::: {.notes}

数据：CHFS 2013（28,141 户、267 县、29 省）算出省级 Gini，区间 0.49 至 0.66；CUGS 2015（3,513 人、50 个地级市）提供中介、结果与个体控制变量。

第一步的累积链接模型在 Gini 上的系数：政治效能 -0.364（p<0.001）、治理平等 -0.375（p<0.001）、司法公正 -0.259（p=0.003）、反腐满意 -0.263（p=0.002）。

第二步的中介效应（1 至 4 分信任量表）。中央：反腐 -0.016（p=0.004）、回应性 -0.005（p=0.032）、司法 -0.008（p=0.038）、公正治理 -0.004（p=0.104，不显著）。地方：反腐 -0.024（p=0.006）、回应性 -0.009（p<0.001）、司法 -0.007（p=0.018）、公正治理 -0.003（不显著）。

公正治理为何落空：公正与不平等一样是一个相对概念，需要与他人比较才能判断。作者的原话是“it might be difficult for citizens to realize whether the government has treated everyone equally”。而不回应和腐败是直接经历的。

效应量作者自陈不大，并归因于 Gini 与信任两端的方差都小。附录 A6 有完整表。

:::

## Wrap up 

::: {.nonincremental}

- Higher inequality [&rarr;]{.large} the poor: 
    - Reject meritocracy [less]{.red}
    - [Less]{.red} likely to gain class consciousness

::: 

- Inequality doesn't have to be known to mess with you
    - Inequality builds a sociopolitical circumstance
    - The circumstance could reach you through your cognition of
        - [Impartial governance]{.grayLight}
        - Government Non-responsiveness
        - Judicial Injustice
        - Anti-Corruption Inadequacy

# Methodological Summary

Regression-based "causality"---on what grounds?


## Tip 1: Design Before Estimation

::: {.callout-tip}

## Credibility starts with how the data are chosen, not with the estimator

:::

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}

**Temporal ordering**

Inequality measured in 2013 [&rarr;]{.large} attitudes measured in 2015

- Reverse causation ruled out [by design]{.red}
- Not corrected at the estimation stage

:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

**Independent sources**

CHFS 2013 [&rarr;]{.large} treatment
CUGS 2015 [&rarr;]{.large} mediators and outcomes

- Avoids [common-source bias]{.red}

:::

::::

::: {.notes}

时序在先这一条，作者在正文和附录里各写了一遍：“We avoid this issue to affect the results through data source selection”，以及“we handle this issue through the design phase”。要强调这是一个设计选择，不是事后补救。

同时必须诚实：这只解决了处理到中介这一段。中介与信任都来自 2015 年同一份调查，那一段的内生性仍在，要靠后面的 2SLS 去压。

:::


## Tip 2: Discipline in Estimation

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}

**Use your methods right**

- Do not only focus on the asterisks
- Compute [conditional effects]{.red} across observed values [@BramborEtAl2006]
- Report [how much of the sample]{.red} that range covers [@BerryEtAl2012]

:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

**Modeling the reality**

- All four mediators enter [one]{.red} model
- Each path estimated net of the other three
- Not four separate models shown side by side

:::

::::

::: {.notes}

“同时进入”是一个保守选择。四个中介之间确实相关，Kendall's tau 最高的一对是公正治理与政治效能的 0.62。把它们放进同一个模型会互相吃掉解释力，公正治理的路径很可能就是这样落空的。

作者的处理是透明的：正文保留更保守的全中介设定，附录报告单中介设定。单中介设定下四条路径全部显著，而且总效应也达到显著。他们没有把附录那一版挪到正文来。

这一页的落点：估计阶段的纪律不是为了让结果好看，恰恰是为了让结果更难好看。

:::


## Tip 3: Being Scientific

::: {.callout-important}

## Do the sensitivity analysis

| Channel | Central | Local |
|---|---|---|
| Government responsiveness | 0.10 | 0.15 |
| Impartial governance | 0.10 | [0.05]{.red} |
| Judicial credibility | 0.20 | 0.20 |
| Anti-corruption effectiveness | 0.25 | [0.40]{.blue} |

:::

- The strongest channel is also the [most robust]{.blue}; on the weakest, the authors [decline to draw a conclusion]{.red}
- 2SLS against reverse causation: the forward effect is about [three times]{.blue} the backward one
- Province fixed effects, single-mediator models, income subgroups: conclusions unchanged

::: {.notes}

表中的数是 rho 的临界值：误差项相关达到这个水平时，中介效应变得与零无异 [@ImaiEtAl2010a; @ImaiEtAl2011]。

没有公认的门槛。作者的对照方式是诚实的：低于方法论原文的 0.68，与已发表应用相当（0.2 与 0.39；另一项研究是 0.09 至 0.22），并且指出那些论文的作者也没有声称自己的 rho 足够大。

地方层面的公正治理 rho 只有 0.05，作者的原话是“tends to be too sensitive to make a conclusion”。这一条不是被审稿人挑出来的，是作者自己写进去的。这就是这一页最该讲的地方。

2SLS：针对最可能内生的两条中介（政治效能、反腐满意），排除性约束分别取民族主义、政治知识、腐败普遍性感知。效能到中央信任显著，反向不显著；反腐满意与中央信任互为因果，但前向效应约为反向的三倍。

省级固定效应下唯一的变化是公正治理对中央信任变得显著（p=0.032）。

:::


## Conservative by Design, Honest About Limits

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}

**Conservative choices are part of the argument**

- Provincial Gini flattens within-province variation
- Social desirability pushes answers upward
- The 2015 campaign compressed the variance in trust

[&rarr;]{.large} The effects found are the [lower bounds]{.blue}

::: {.notes}

The first two make the estimate at least an underestimate, and the third makes the effect harder to detect.

:::

:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

**Limits stated up front**

- The total effect is [not significant]{.grayLight}
- Sequential ignorability is [untestable]{.grayLight} [@ImaiEtAl2010; @Wolak2020]
- Replication materials are public

::: {.callout-warning .fragment}

## Proportion

[Causally informed inference]{.red}, not causal inference.

:::

:::

::::


::: {.notes}

总效应不显著这件事，作者在附录里正面处理：中介分析中并不罕见 [@AglerDeBoeck2017]；总效应的标准误同时吸收直接与间接两部分的方差，因此间接效应的检验反而可能更有力 [@KennyJudd2014]。Kenny 与 Judd 的比方是：“It might be very hard to throw a ball 70 m in one throw. However, it is a lot easier to throw the ball 70 m in two throws.” 并且在单中介设定下总效应确实显著。

序贯可忽略性不可检验。作者引 Wolak 的表述，提醒“one needs to be very cautious to interpret the results of this research causally”，并承认用控制变量做的调整很难完备。

这一页建议放慢，它是整场演讲在方法上的可信度来源。愿意讲自己的下界和边界的研究，才值得被相信。

:::


## Where the cognitive perspective goes next

- What common-prosperity policies do to these effects and these mechanisms
- How policy enters individual sociopolitical cognition
- Fieldwork, observational, experimental, big data [&rarr;]{.large} causal inference and practical guidance

::: {.fragment}

> [共同富裕是一个长远目标，需要一个过程，不可能一蹴而就，对其长期性、艰巨性、复杂性要有充分估计，办好这件事，等不得，也急不得。]{.red}<br>
> [—— @XiJinPing2021c]{.red}

:::



::: {.notes}

求是刊登的习近平的一篇文章

三点回顾对应三个板块。

展望要落回开场：既然“看得见、摸得着、真实可感”是一个认知命题，那么政策评估就不能只看分配指标，还要看它有没有改变人的感受，以及经由哪条通道改变。

治理效能这一环是可干预的，这也正是共同富裕政策的着力点之一。

最后一句引文收束：长期性、艰巨性、复杂性，正对应认知维度探索的初步性质。

:::

## Figure placeholder

To be filled with @SoltEtAl2017 Figure 2: the six surveys arrayed side by side, what Gelman calls the secret weapon.

:::

- Six surveys: 2005-10, 2006-09, 2007-07, 2008-01, 2008-10, 2009-04
- Positive and significant in [2006-09]{.red} only, the one survey the target used
- Not one of the other five is significant, and in [three]{.red} the point estimate is negative

::: {.notes}

这是这一对论文里最好的一张教学图：同一个模型，只换数据，结论就翻转。它说明结果是数据选择的性质，不是模型的性质。

系数的横轴跨度大致从 -5 到 +10（对数几率），即 2006 年之外的估计都极不精确。

原文引 King、Keohane 与 Verba 的话作为依据：“We should be willing to take whatever information we can acquire so long as it helps us learn about the veracity of our theory” [@KingEtAl1994]。

## Estimating Inequality and Meritocracy

*Target* [@SoltEtAl2016]

> Which statement do you agree with:
>
> - Most people who want to get ahead can make it if they're willing to work hard
> - Hard work and determination are no guarantee of success for most people

*Model*: multilevel logistic regression, individuals nested in counties, with both the intercept and the coefficient for income allowed to vary across counties

$$
\begin{align}
\color{red}{Reject}\thinspace Meritocracy_{ij} =\boldsymbol{X\gamma} &+ \gamma_{10}Income_{ij} + \gamma_{01}Inequality_{j}\\
        &+ \gamma_{11}Inequality_{j} \times Income_{ij} + u_{ij}
\end{align}
$$

*Conditional effect*

$$
\frac{\partial\thinspace Reject\thinspace Meritocracy}{\partial\thinspace Inequality} = \gamma_{01} + \gamma_{11}Income
$$

::: {.notes}

收入按 1 至 9 编码（低于 1 万美元至高于 15 万美元）。县级控制变量：平均收入、黑人人口占比、2004 年布什得票率、总人口。个体控制变量：年龄、教育、性别、种族、公民身份、党派认同、意识形态、教会出席频率。缺失值用 R 包 mi 多重插补 [@Rubin1987; @SuEtAl2011]。

不平等测量的局限，作者自己写在脚注里：ACS 县级 Gini 的福利定义是转移支付后、税前收入。由于大量再分配通过税法实现，税后指标更可取，但美国在低于全国的地理层级上几乎没有税后收入分布数据。

:::


## Marginal Effects on Class Consciousness and Meritocracy

::: {.r-hstack}

![](https://drhuyue.site:10002/sammo3182/figure/inequality_class2.png){fig-align="center" height=560}

![](https://drhuyue.site:10002/sammo3182/figure/spec_interaction2.jpg){.fragment fig-align="center" height=560}

:::

::: {.notes}

图片与论文的对应关系待图床恢复后核对，届时补上准确图注。

:::


## Three Incomparable Measures of Meritocracy

| Measure | Survey years | Item format | Counted as rejection when |
|---|---|---|---|
| Measure 1 | 2005, 2006 | Forced choice | "Hard work is no guarantee" chosen |
| Measure 2 | 2007 | Two four-point items | [Both]{.red} agreed with |
| Measure 3 | 2009 | The same two items | [Only the first]{.red} considered |

- Measure 2 yields [much lower]{.red} rejection than either of the others
- Measure 3 often yields [considerably higher]{.red} levels than Measure 1
- The 1999-2012 series shows the three are [not comparable]{.red}

::: {.notes}

原文的判断：把它们合并进单一分析无法成立。而对手论文正是把四次调查、三种测量合并的，理由是要凑足够多的地方情境。

对手在脚注与在线附录中辩称，只用 2005 至 2006（单一 Measure 1）跑出的结果与合并结果相似。2016 的在线附录逐一重跑，显示三种测量下结果差异相当大，且无论哪种测量，条件效应在任何观测收入水平上都达不到甚至接近不了显著。

:::


## Measurement in the Chinese Case [@JinEtAl2024]

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}

*Data*

**CHFS 2013**

- 28,141 households, 267 counties, 29 provinces
- Used only to construct the [provincial Gini]{.red} (0.49 to 0.66)

**CUGS 2015**

- 3,513 respondents, 50 prefectures
- Representative of urban citizens nationwide
- Supplies mediators, outcomes, individual controls

:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

*Measurement*

- Impartial governance [&larr;]{.large} perceived equality of government treatment
- Responsiveness [&larr;]{.large} external political efficacy
- Judicial credibility [&larr;]{.large} trust in the fairness of courts and procuratorates
- Anti-corruption [&larr;]{.large} satisfaction with anti-corruption efforts
- Outcome: trust in the central and in the local government, 1 to 4

:::

::::

::: {.notes}

省级而非市级是数据所限，不是设计选择：CHFS 脱敏后无法在更低层级计算 Gini。作者明确指出，更同质、更平的省级测量很可能导致对不平等影响的低估。

信任的描述统计：中央均值 3.27（标准差 0.64），地方 2.98（标准差 0.75）。分层信任的格局在中国政治中是稳定的 [@Li2004a]。

个体控制变量：性别、年龄、城镇化、教育、流动身份、家庭收入、职业类型、党员身份。情境控制变量：本地 GDP、人口、平均工资、政府财政收入。

:::


## Full Mediation Results

**Trust in the central government**

| Channel | Mediation effect | p |
|---|---|---|
| Anti-corruption | -0.016 | 0.004 |
| Judicial credibility | -0.008 | 0.038 |
| Responsiveness | -0.005 | 0.032 |
| Impartial governance | [-0.004]{.grayLight} | [0.104]{.grayLight} |
| *Direct effect* | [-0.015]{.grayLight} | [0.502]{.grayLight} |

**Trust in the local government**

| Channel | Mediation effect | p |
|---|---|---|
| Anti-corruption | -0.024 | 0.006 |
| Responsiveness | -0.009 | <0.001 |
| Judicial credibility | -0.007 | 0.018 |
| Impartial governance | [-0.003]{.grayLight} | [0.306]{.grayLight} |
| *Direct effect* | [0.001]{.grayLight} | [0.940]{.grayLight} |

::: {.notes}

量纲是 1 至 4 分的信任量表，因此绝对值都很小。作者自陈：“the income inequality in 2015 was not powerful enough to substantively shake one of the highest political trusts in the world”，尽管统计上显著。

总效应在两级均不显著（p 均大于 0.17）。附录报告的单中介设定下总效应达到显著（中央 -0.0586 至 -0.0627，p ≤ 0.004；地方 -0.0432 至 -0.0506，p = 0.022 至 0.042）。

:::


## Sensitivity Analysis

*Tipping-point rho*: the residual correlation at which the mediation effect becomes indistinguishable from zero

| Channel | Central | Local |
|---|---|---|
| Government responsiveness | 0.10 | 0.15 |
| Impartial governance | 0.10 | [0.05]{.red} |
| Judicial credibility | 0.20 | 0.20 |
| Anti-corruption effectiveness | 0.25 | [0.40]{.blue} |

*Benchmarks*

- The original methodological paper: 0.68 [@ImaiEtAl2010]
- Published applications: 0.2 and 0.39 [@ImaiEtAl2011]; 0.09 to 0.22 [@Wolak2020]
- In none of those did the authors [claim]{.red} their rho was large enough

::: {.notes}

作者的结论措辞：在偏离中介可忽略性的一定范围内，结论仍可成立；但没有关于 rho 多大才算足够大的清晰标准或经验法则。

地方层面的公正治理是唯一被作者主动排除的路径，理由是过于敏感。由于他们本来就没有在该路径上提出实质发现，这不损害整体论证。

:::


## Endogeneity and Spatial Robustness

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}

**2SLS simultaneous equations**

Applied to the two mediators most plausibly endogenous

| Endogenous variable | Exclusion restriction |
|---|---|
| Political trust | Nationalism |
| Political efficacy | Political knowledge |
| Anti-corruption satisfaction | Perceived corruption prevalence |

- Efficacy [&rarr;]{.large} central trust significant, [the reverse is not]{.grayLight}
- Anti-corruption satisfaction and trust are reciprocal, but forward is about [three times]{.blue} backward

:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

**Other robustness checks**

- Province fixed effects: no substantive differences
    - Only change: impartial governance [turns significant]{.blue} for central trust (p = 0.032)
- Single-mediator models: all four paths and the total effect significant
- Income subgroups: no conclusive differences
- Urban sampling balance: 0.563 vs 0.569 (p = 0.467)

:::

::::

::: {.notes}

多重共线性：Kendall's tau 中，公正治理与政治效能 0.62、与司法公正 0.52，司法与效能 0.46；反腐满意与其余仅 0.25 至 0.27。作者的处理是正文保留保守的全中介设定，附录报告单中介设定，并说明在现有数据中找不到既能避开共线性又能控制其他中介混淆的工具。

社会赞许性无法检验，作者的论证是信任类问题不涉及受访者自身行为，作答相对诚实；且任何偏误都推向更正面的回答和更小的方差，因此测到的负效应是低估。

:::
